title: KDB+/Q Developer
description:
A nossa paixão coloca-nos no lugar certo.

A CodeWin nasceu da fusão de duas empresas líderes no setor tecnológico: Decode e Sowin . Unimos a nossa paixão, os nossos talentos, conhecimentos e experiências para levar até às nossas pessoas e parceiros as melhores soluções em transformação digital e consultoria. A nossa expertise assenta em Software Development, ERP, CRM, Data Strategy e Digital Experiences.

Queremos contribuir para um mundo melhor e sabemos que isso só é possível equilibrando a evolução tecnológica com o bem-estar das empresas, pessoas e sociedade. Para isso, precisamos das pessoas certas. Para isso, precisamos de ti!


O que precisas para ter o nosso CODE:


  • Licenciatura em Engenharia Informática/Gestão/Economia ou similar;
  • 5+ anos de experiência profissional com KDB+ e com a Linguagem Q
  • Experiência profissional com a arquitetura do sistema, funções nativas, e interação com hardwares;
  • Experiência com Linux/Unix
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipa;
  • Fluente em Inglês e Português;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo híbrido em São Paulo, ou remoto.


O que temos para ser o WIN que te falta:

- Acompanhamento personalizado. Preocupamo-nos com o teu bem-estar e desenvolvimento. Queremos proporcionar-te o equilíbrio certo entre a tua vida pessoal e profissional, queremos ver-te evoluir.

- Trabalhamos com um objetivo. Somos flexíveis no horário e oferecemos a possibilidade de trabalho remoto. O importante é cumprires os teus objetivos e sentires-te realizado.

- Investimos na tua carreira. Damos-te acesso a formação certificada, plataformas online e centro de exames Pearson VUE.

- Experiência e destaque no mercado tecnológico. A CodeWin pertence a um grupo multinacional com 24 marcas, mais de 7.000 colaboradores e presença em 14 países.

- Um conjunto de benefícios para o teu dia-a-dia. Seguro de saúde, seguro de vida e acidentes pessoais, um leque de descontos e benefícios, plano de telecomunicações e muito mais.

- Damos importância ao que realmente importa. Disponibilizamos-te consultas gratuitas de medicina geral, nutrição e psicologia.


Queremos marcar pela diferença com as nossas ideias e soluções. Para isso, precisamos de ti e de unir as nossas forças. Aceitas o desafio?


All in the right place



*Na CodeWin, defendemos a igualdade e valorizamos a diversidade. Criamos um ambiente seguro, diversificado, onde as oportunidades são iguais para todos os colaboradores! title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Roteirista Redes Sociais (Finanças e Economia)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Roteirista de Redes Sociais (Finanças/Economia) para integrar nosso time na VAROS.


A VAROS é uma das principais empresas do mercado financeiro brasileiro, com atuação nas áreas de Wealth Management, Research e Educacional. Nós valorizamos o esforço e premiamos o resultado, aplicando um modelo de partnership que permite a rápida ascensão dos colaboradores dentro da empresa.


Como Roteirista, você será responsável por pensar e criar os roteiros de vídeos curtos e longos sobre finanças, economia, investimento e geopolítica que serão usados nos vídeos divulgados nas redes sociais da VAROS e de seus sócios.


Você terá uma rotina dinâmica, criativa, com desafios diários, feedback constante e contato direto com os sócios, possibilitando uma rápida ascensão.


Responsabilidades

  • Escolha de temas e elaboração de cronograma para vídeos de finanças, economia, geopolítica e investimentos no Instagram e Youtube;
  • Realizar pesquisa técnica coletando informações e dados de diversas fontes para contribuir com a criação do roteiro;
  • Escrever roteiros de vídeos longos para o canal do YouTube da VAROS e/ou dos sócios (8 a 20 minutos), sobre temas de finanças, economia, geopolítica e mercado financeiro;
  • Escrever roteiros de Reels e TikToks (1 a 3 minutos) adaptando temas complexos para formatos curtos e de alto engajamento;
  • Manter consistência com o tom de voz da marca: conversacional, didático, com exemplos numéricos concretos em R$, sem jargão desnecessário;
  • Colaboração com o time de edição no intuito de garantir que a visão do roteiro seja traduzida fielmente para o vídeo final. Isso inclui revisar cortes preliminares, sugerir ajustes de ritmo, validar escolhas de gráficos e b-rolls e estar disponível pra tirar dúvidas do editor sobre intenção e timing.
  • Sugerir títulos e ideias de thumbs pensados em engajamento.


Requisitos


Formação e Experiência

  • Graduação em Jornalismo, Economia, Relações Internacionais ou Engenharia;
  • 3 anos ou mais de experiência como roteirista, redator, repórter ou produtor de conteúdo;
  • Portfólio com roteiros publicados;


Hard Skills

  • Domínio sólido dos fundamentos de mercado financeiro brasileiro: renda fixa, renda variável, macroeconomia, leitura de balanços e indicadores econômicos.
  • Excelente habilidade de escrita;
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura);


Soft Skills

  • Organização;
  • Criatividade


Ferramentas

  • Excel intermediário;
  • Notion;
  • IA (Claude, Perplexity);


Nós oferecemos:

  • Remuneração extremamente competitiva;

title: \"SAP BTP IS Cloud Integration Developer #1002182\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

title: Technical Advisor (Energia Elétrica)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como orientador técnico no cliente;
  • Resolver problemas de negócios do cliente (análise de requisitos e desenho da solução);
  • Elaborar/acompanhar o plano de trabalho para a expansão do sistema ArcGIS junto aos clientes;
  • Engajar seus clientes na utilização do sistema ArcGIS;
  • Atuar em conjunto a equipe de vendas no desenho de soluções, sendo responsável por liderar as estimativas para implementação;
  • Buscar o melhor uso da plataforma ArcGIS nos clientes de sua indústria de atuação;
  • Criar propostas de melhorias de otimização dentro dos projetos para facilitar o alcance aos objetivos dos clientes;
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos, identificar os processos de negócio, entender as necessidades e traduzir para o time de desenvolvimento;
  • Criar apresentações e realizar demonstrações para os clientes de forma que apresente o avanço do desenvolvimento e garanta o alinhamento e expectativa do cliente para as atividades futuras;
  • Saber negociar a priorização de atividades e tratar conflitos;
  • Interagir com o cliente, Gerente de Contas e profissionais das áreas internas como, por exemplo: Comercial, Marketing, Professional Services e Suporte Técnico.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação

  • Graduação em área de Tecnologia e Especialização completas.


Habilidades Técnicas

  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de soluções;
  • Conhecimento das práticas de gestão de projetos;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis;
  • Tecnologias orientadas para mercados verticais;
  • Conhecimentos avançado na plataforma ArGIS.


Habilidades Desejáveis

  • Mestrado ou Doutorado;
  • Certificações Esri;
  • Inglês para leitura, escrita e conversação;
  • Conhecimento sólido em TI;
  • Conhecimento na plataforma ArcGIS (Desktop, Enterprise, AGOL e Apps);
  • Conhecimento das práticas de gestão de projetos;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS / GIS)
description:
Gerente de Technical Advisor (GIS / ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
  • Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
  • Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
  • Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
  • Gestão do atendimento dos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços
  • Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
  • Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
  • Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
  • Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo
  • Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
  • Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Experiência com o ArcGIS;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão em profundidade os produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: SRE - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa SRE Pleno. Essa pessoa atuará no time de MLOps, responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura que suporta os modelos e pipelines de Machine Learning em produção. Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, com forte cultura de engenharia e incentivo ao desenvolvimento contínuo. Tudo isso em uma empresa líder no mercado brasileiro de farmácia, referência em Saúde e Bem-estar com mais 3.000 lojas em todos os estados brasileiros.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform, seguindo padrões e boas práticas já estabelecidos pelo time.
  • Operar e dar manutenção em clusters Kubernetes, utilizando Helm e práticas de GitOps para suporte à entrega contínua de aplicações.
  • Atuar na operação do dia a dia de ambientes AWS, contribuindo para a disponibilidade e estabilidade das plataformas.
  • Apoiar o diagnóstico de problemas de rede em cloud providers, atuando em conjunto com membros mais sêniores do time em cenários mais complexos.
  • Manter pipelines de CI/CD com GitLab, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento e dados.
  • Acompanhar e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) para identificar anomalias e apoiar a resposta a incidentes.
  • Participar de processos de resposta a incidentes e post-mortems, contribuindo com análises e implementação de melhorias.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, auxiliando na identificação de oportunidades de otimização de custos na nuvem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios


  • Experiência prática com Terraform para gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código.
  • Conhecimento sólido em AWS.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo uso de Helm e fluxos GitOps.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em GitLab (pipelines, CI/CD, repositórios).
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico em redes em ambientes cloud (VPC, security groups, DNS, load balancers, etc.).
  • Bom domínio de Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana e Datadog.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento introdutório de práticas de FinOps em ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência ou interesse em ambientes de MLOps ou Data EngineeringPerfil comportamental
  • Boa capacidade de resolução de problemas e raciocínio analítico, com vontade de evoluir em cenários de infraestrutura e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Comunicação clara e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Perfil com senso de dono, proativo e aberto a aprender com o time.

title: Especialista em infraestrutura de TI - Temporário
description:
Objetivo do papel no projeto

Estamos em busca de um especialista em Infraestrutura / Data Center com sólida experiência em ambientes corporativos ou bancários, atuando em capacity planning, alta disponibilidade, arquitetura de data centers e continuidade de serviços de TI.

Vivência em ambientes ativo‑ativo, análise de carregamento, storage, virtualização e suporte a testes de contingência.

Atribuições

  • Análise de capacidade atual e futura de:
  • compute (clusters, virtualização, CPU, memória);
  • storage (capacidade, IOPS, latência, replicação);
  • network (largura de banda, latência inter‑DC).
  • Interpretação de métricas históricas e tendências.
  • Elaboração de cenários prospectivos :
  • crescimento orgânico;
  • contingência (DC único absorvendo 100% da carga);
  • iniciativas estratégicas (ex.: IA, aumento de criticidade).
  • Avaliação técnica de: arquitetura físico‑lógica dos Data Center (DCs), modelo ativo‑ativo real , incluindo exceções técnicas e dependências entre sistemas e infraestrutura.
  • Análise comparativa de alternativas (enterprise e colocation);
  • Suporte a entregáveis e transferência de conhecimento
  • Contribuição técnica para elaboração de relatórios e parecer técnico.


  • Experiência necessária
  • 5 anos em infraestrutura de TI corporativa ou bancária;
  • Vivência comprovada em Data Centers de médio/grande porte ;
  • Experiência prévia com ambientes ativo‑ativo ou alta disponibilidade e projetos de continuidade ou contingência.


  • Conhecimentos técnicos
  • Virtualização (VMware / Hyper‑V / equivalentes);
  • Storage enterprise (SAN, replicação síncrona/quase síncrona);
  • Networks de alta disponibilidade (LAN/WAN, inter‑DC);
  • Capacidade, performance, latência e gargalos.

title: Especialista em infraestrutura de TI - Temporário
description:
Objetivo do papel no projeto

Estamos em busca de um especialista em Infraestrutura / Data Center com sólida experiência em ambientes corporativos ou bancários, atuando em capacity planning, alta disponibilidade, arquitetura de data centers e continuidade de serviços de TI.

Vivência em ambientes ativo‑ativo, análise de carregamento, storage, virtualização e suporte a testes de contingência.

Atribuições

  • Análise de capacidade atual e futura de:
  • compute (clusters, virtualização, CPU, memória);
  • storage (capacidade, IOPS, latência, replicação);
  • network (largura de banda, latência inter‑DC).
  • Interpretação de métricas históricas e tendências.
  • Elaboração de cenários prospectivos :
  • crescimento orgânico;
  • contingência (DC único absorvendo 100% da carga);
  • iniciativas estratégicas (ex.: IA, aumento de criticidade).
  • Avaliação técnica de: arquitetura físico‑lógica dos Data Center (DCs), modelo ativo‑ativo real , incluindo exceções técnicas e dependências entre sistemas e infraestrutura.
  • Análise comparativa de alternativas (enterprise e colocation);
  • Suporte a entregáveis e transferência de conhecimento
  • Contribuição técnica para elaboração de relatórios e parecer técnico.


  • Experiência necessária
  • 5 anos em infraestrutura de TI corporativa ou bancária;
  • Vivência comprovada em Data Centers de médio/grande porte ;
  • Experiência prévia com ambientes ativo‑ativo ou alta disponibilidade e projetos de continuidade ou contingência.


  • Conhecimentos técnicos
  • Virtualização (VMware / Hyper‑V / equivalentes);
  • Storage enterprise (SAN, replicação síncrona/quase síncrona);
  • Networks de alta disponibilidade (LAN/WAN, inter‑DC);
  • Capacidade, performance, latência e gargalos.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
International Marketing Specialist | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and execution-driven Marketing Assistant to support digital marketing operations for international clients.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Digital Marketing and Marketing Operations.


What We Offer

  • Compensation of R$5,000
  • 100% remote, aligned with PST working hours
  • Direct exposure to international clients and global teams
  • Long-term position
  • Participation in strategic digital marketing projects
  • Structured, dynamic, and performance-driven environment
  • Real growth opportunities into higher-responsibility roles


Your Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end execution of digital marketing campaigns
  • Assist in organizing scopes, timelines, and KPIs
  • Update and manage project management tools (Asana, ClickUp, Jira, Trello)
  • Coordinate communication between designers, copywriters, media buyers, and developers
  • Ensure organization of briefings, assets, and documentation
  • Track creative deliverables and deadlines
  • Collect and organize campaign performance metrics (paid media, social, email, SEO)
  • Support KPI analysis and performance reporting
  • Identify potential operational risks and escalate when necessary
  • Participate in internal meetings and, when needed, client calls
  • Prepare summaries and follow-ups to ensure team alignment


What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in digital marketing or agency environment
  • Experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Familiarity with project management tools
  • Functional knowledge of digital channels (social, paid media, email, SEO, landing pages)
  • Advanced or fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, remote environments


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in agencies or startups
  • Experience working with international clients
  • Knowledge of dashboards and performance reporting
  • Certifications in digital marketing or project management


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with good performance
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet and structured home office


Build your international career in Marketing.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer (Web, Mobile & CTV/OTT)
description:
Role: Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer (Web, Mobile & CTV/OTT)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Contract


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Tracking & Digital Analytics Engineer to support analytics and tracking implementation across web, mobile (iOS/Android), and CTV/OTT platforms for a large-scale streaming product. This is a hands-on implementation and QA-focused role.


The engineer will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Analytics teams to ensure accurate data capture, validation, and measurement across digital platforms.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Translate business and product requirements into clear tracking specifications
  • Implement and validate analytics tracking across Web, iOS, Android, and CTV/OTT platforms
  • Perform data validation, QA checks, and event verification
  • Troubleshoot tracking issues and data discrepancies
  • Validate third-party measurement tools such as Nielsen and comScore
  • Maintain tracking documentation and support release readiness


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Strong experience with digital analytics tracking implementation
  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics
  • Experience with Tealium or similar tag management tools (Adobe Launch, GTM, etc.)
  • Strong background in analytics QA, validation, and debugging
  • Experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


Platforms:

  • Web applications
  • Mobile apps (iOS & Android)
  • OTT / CTV platforms
  • Streaming / digital media products

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Security: Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources.
  • Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.g., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements.
  • HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control.
  • Automation and Scripting:
  • Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build).
  • DevOps and Monitoring:
  • Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments.
  • Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.g., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly.
  • Data and Analytics:
  • Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads.
  • Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.g., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications.
  • Data Integration: Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.g., Cloud Data Fusion, Apache Airflow) for building data pipelines.
  • Cloud Architecture:
  • Design Patterns: Understanding of cloud-native design patterns and best practices for building scalable, resilient, and cost-effective solutions.
  • Microservices: Experience with microservices architecture and related technologies (e.g., Istio, Envoy) for building and managing distributed applications.
  • API Management: Proficiency in API management tools (e.g., Apigee) for designing, securing, and monitoring APIs.


Required Qualifications

Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.

Cloud Infrastructure:

Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.g., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions).

Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.g., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN).

Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.


Contratação CLT + Benefícios

Equipe internacional.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Social Media / Blogger / Data Analytics Intern
description:
Calling All Awesome Marketing Interns!!!


We are looking for a creative and data-driven intern to support our content and marketing efforts. This role is perfect for someone who enjoys storytelling, content creation, and analyzing performance to improve results.


The program is a 3-month remote internship , during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week. This is an unpaid program whose end goal is to provide students with a higher chance of getting hired in the digital marketing space after completing our apprenticeship program.


What’s In It For You?

  • It’s (100%) fully remote position and offers flexibility in schedule.
  • You’ll have clear goals and the training resources you need to deliver.
  • Access our free courses on the platform that you can finish at your own pace.
  • 1 to 2 hours of mentorship every week.
  • Issued certification upon successfully completing the program.
  • Boost your portfolio and grow your professional network
  • Get to utilize and elevate your digital marketing skills in real projects
  • You have a high chance of being hired by your mentor during or after the apprenticeship, depending on your performance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Film and edit engaging content for social media platforms
  • Write SEO-optimized blog posts to drive organic traffic
  • Monitor and analyze website and social media performance
  • Track key metrics and provide insights for content improvement
  • Assist in developing content strategies based on analytics


Requirements:

  • Strong interest in social media, blogging, and digital marketing
  • Basic knowledge of SEO principles and content writing
  • Familiarity with video editing tools (e.g., CapCut, Adobe Premiere, etc.)
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Google Analytics or similar tools
  • Basic graphic design skills
  • Understanding of social media trends and algorithms



About us:

Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team.


What We Value:

  • Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions
  • Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated
  • Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions
  • Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough
  • Discipline - Be consistent in your actions
  • Ambition - Aspire to become better every day
  • Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Resume:

English version only.

Highlight SAAS projects, healthcare related projects, and HIPAA experience.

Highlight experiences in .NET MVC and .NET Maui


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Senior Angular Developer (Angular and Electron)
description:
At Intellias , we're always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our team in Colombia. Over 20 years of market experience, Intellias brings together technologists, creators and innovators in Europe, North and Latin America, and the Middle East. Join our international team and take the mission to solve the advanced tech challenges of tomorrow!


If you're enthusiastic about contributing your skills and experience to our organization, we invite you to submit your CV for this position.


What we offer you in Intellias

  • B2B Contract
  • Fixed hour-based salary. You should have a private entrepreneurs (PE) and open US dollar bank account.
  • Corporate courses (Udemy, LinkedIn Learning and O'Raily)
  • Technical equipment on request
  • 100% English environment


Requirements:


  • English B2/C1
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development
  • Highly Proficient in Angular 20, TypeScript, JavaScript, ES8+, HTML5, CSS3.
  • Proficient in test-driven development, automated testing, and the use of testing frameworks
  • Experience with Less/Sass CSS Pre-processors
  • Experience in the area of modular and scalable software development
  • Experience maintaining a living and complex codebase with a modern stack
  • Designing and developing reusable, testable front end components
  • Desire to learn cutting edge technology to solve complex business problems
  • Experience with Electron, Webpack, NodeJS, Vue.js, NPM, SVG


Responsabilities


  • Develop and maintain modern web solutions as a Senior Engineer within the Web Team using Angular 18, JavaScript, TypeScript (ES8+), HTML5, and CSS3 .
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable UI components for web and desktop platforms, including Web, Windows, and macOS applications.
  • Establish and uphold high‑quality, maintainable, and performant coding standards , ensuring consistency across multiple platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers, QA teams, and UX designers to deliver new features and enhancements for next‑generation applications.
  • Contribute to architecture design, technical decisions, design patterns, and development best practices .
  • Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing .
  • Drive continuous improvement in frontend architecture, performance, and user experience .
  • Own features from concept and design through implementation and delivery , ensuring alignment with both business and technical goals .

title: Digital Marketing Ad Strategist
description:
The Digital Marketing Ad Strategist is a responsible for the performance, health, and scalability of paid advertising accounts across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and LinkedIn Ads. This role is heavily focused on account audits, ongoing optimization, technical troubleshooting, and performance improvements.

You will analyze existing ad accounts, identify inefficiencies and technical issues, recommend and implement fixes, and ensure tracking, structure, and strategy are aligned with business objectives.


Requirements

  • In-depth knowledge of the following platforms: Google ads, Facebook Ads, Microsoft Ads
  • Detail oriented



Key Responsibilities


Account Audits & Diagnostics

 • Conduct in-depth audits of Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft, and LinkedIn Ads accounts. Experience or working knowledge across secondary platforms, including TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, X, Snapchat, Spotify, and Amazon.

 • Identify structural issues, wasted spend, tracking gaps, and performance blockers

 • Diagnose bugs and technical issues such as:

 • Incorrect or missing conversion tracking

 • Pixel or tag misfires

 • Attribution and reporting discrepancies

 • Budget pacing and delivery issues

 • Audience overlap and campaign cannibalization

 • Document findings and deliver clear, prioritized optimization recommendations


 Optimization & Performance Management

• Continuous proactive optimization of campaigns, ad groups, keywords, audiences, bids, and creatives

 • Improve key performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate

 • Manage and reallocate budgets based on performance and growth opportunities

 • Plan and execute A/B tests across targeting, creative, offers, and landing pages

 • Optimize accounts across full-funnel stages (awareness, consideration, conversion)


 Strategy & Execution

 • Translate business goals into effective paid media strategies

 • Ensure account structures align with funnel intent and buyer journeys

 • Align ad messaging with audience intent and platform best practices


 Tracking, Data & Reporting

 • Ensure accurate setup and ongoing validation of conversion tracking

 • Work with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and platform analytics to confirm data integrity

 • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, issues, and opportunities

 • Create performance reports that clearly explain results, risks, and next steps


 Process & Quality Control

• Maintain clean account structure, naming conventions, and documentation

 • Build and follow optimization and audit checklists

 • Stay current on platform updates, policy changes, and best practices

 • Proactively flag risks, inefficiencies, or declining performance trends


Additional Tasks

 • Forecasts and initial ad spend recommendations to assist with the Sales team.

 • Have basic design knowledge and be able to coordinate ad copy and creative with internal team members.


Language Requirements

 • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Salary

$3000 BRL (Brazilian Real) / Per Month to start

Benefits after 6 months


Hiring Process:

Initial Interview with small knowledge test

Second interview with Ads team

Possible follow up questions / test

  • Final meet and greet meeting

title: Linux Server Manager
description:
Cargo: Linux Server Manager

Local de atuação: Remoto

Horário de Trabalho: Horário Comercial

Idioma: Inglês Fluente

Contrato : 1 ano, podendo prorrogar.


Job Description: Server Manager (Global Project)

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.

title: Linux Server Manager
description:
Cargo: Linux Server Manager

Local de atuação: Remoto

Horário de Trabalho: Horário Comercial

Idioma: Inglês Fluente

Contrato : 1 ano, podendo prorrogar.


Job Description: Server Manager (Global Project)

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.

description:
The ideal candidate will provide top-level assistance for high level executives. They should be well-organized and be comfortable scheduling meetings and responding to emails on the executive's behalf. Lastly, this individual should be able to draft documents and help the executive with any necessary meeting preparations.  

Responsibilities
  • Calendar management for executives
  • Aid executive in preparing for meetings
  • Responding to emails and document requests on behalf of executives
  • Draft slides, meeting notes and documents for executives


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite
  • Experience in managing multiple priorities, administrative coordination, and logistics
  • Well-organized, detail-oriented, ability to multi-task with great follow-up skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

title: Java Developer - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer – Help Shape the Future of Continuous Delivery at a Global Financial Technology Leader!


Join a mission-critical engineering organisation at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial messaging and payments platforms. Become part of a global DevOps Engineering Services team enabling modern software delivery, automation, and orchestration across a highly complex, secure, and fast-moving technology landscape. Supporting internal engineering teams across the enterprise, you’ll contribute to a mature and rapidly expanding initiative driving CI/CD/RO adoption - powering over 100+ applications and accelerating delivery excellence for teams primarily across the United States.


This is your opportunity to work inside a global organisation transforming the way software is built, released, and operated - while collaborating with senior engineers and DevOps experts across continents.


Your Role as a DevOps Engineer

As a DevOps Engineer within the DevOps Engineering Services team, you’ll help deliver internal tooling, automation, and release orchestration capabilities that empower hundreds of developers and application teams.

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. You'll contribute to a mature programme governed by senior engineers, with clear guidance, structured delivery, and high-impact outcomes across enterprise DevOps environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Support adoption of CI/CD and RO tooling across internal DevOps teams
  • Work closely with Senior Engineers to execute release orchestration onboarding tasks
  • Assist in scaling the enterprise adoption of CloudBees RO, Jenkins, CloudBees CI/CD
  • Enable best practices for Git workflows, artefact management (Nexus), and code quality (SonarQube)
  • Support SAST/DAST integration within secure delivery pipelines
  • Provide technical support to internal teams as they adopt enterprise DevOps tooling
  • Contribute to IaC and automation efforts using Python and Ansible Automation Platform
  • Support containerisation initiatives using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Collaborate in an Agile, DevSecOps-driven environment to standardise delivery processes
  • Ensure accurate documentation, repeatable execution, and alignment to engineering guidelines


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of DevOps engineering experience within Banking/Financial services.
  • Hands-on expertise with CI/CD tooling
  • Hands on experience with Jenkins, Git, Nexus, SonarQube
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools
  • Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible
  • Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles
  • Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based)
  • Ability to follow established engineering patterns and execute with precision


Why Join the Remobi Community

  • 100% remote B2B/freelance contracts
  • Access to a global network of top-tier engineering opportunities
  • Curated content, role alerts, and a supportive contractor community


Apply today: If you're ready to elevate software delivery excellence at scale and support a global CDRO transformation initiative - we want to hear from you!
