title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
TATEEDA | GLOBAL is a custom software development and staff augmentation company based in San Diego, California. With a team of over 100 skilled engineers, we excel in creating scalable, high-impact software solutions across various industries. Recognized for our innovation and growth, we have ranked among the Fastest Growing Private Companies by the San Diego Business Journal for five consecutive years. Our commitment to excellence has also earned us a spot on the Inc. 5000 list in both 2022 and 2024.


Role Description

This is a long-term contract, remote Senior Python Engineer role for a healthcare client. You will be responsible for building and maintaining reporting and analytics systems that process large healthcare datasets. The position requires someone with deep expertise in Python and pandas who can design efficient data pipelines, create automated reporting solutions, and ensure data accuracy and compliance in a healthcare environment.

What we are looking for:

• Minimum 7 years of professional Python development experience

• Expert-level proficiency with pandas for data manipulation and analysis

• Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server)

• Proven experience building reporting and analytics systems

• Experience working with large, complex datasets

• Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance requirements

• Healthcare industry experience is a strong plus

• Knowledge of healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR, ICD-10) is a bonus

• Familiarity with HIPAA compliance and healthcare data privacy is a plus

• Experience with data visualization tools (Matplotlib, Plotly, Tableau, Power BI) is beneficial •

Comfortable working remotely and communicating clearly in English

• Located in Brazil or Latin America

The role:

• Full-time remote contract

• Long-term engagement with healthcare client

• Work with collaborative team of engineers

• Build ETL pipelines and automated reporting systems

• Ensure data accuracy, security, and compliance

• Opportunity to work with modern Python stack and healthcare data

To apply: Send your CV to

title: Assistente de marketing PCD
description:
Assistente de marketing - exclusivo PCD


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa apaixonada por marketing, organizada e com vontade de aprender, para atuar como Assistente de Marketing PCD em um ambiente dinâmico, multicultural e com atuação em toda a América Latina


Se você gosta de colocar a mão na massa, transita bem entre diferentes frentes de marketing e quer crescer na área, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar na execução de campanhas de marketing digital (B2C e B2B);
  • Dar suporte na gestão e atualização de conteúdos para redes sociais;
  • Auxiliar em estratégias de SEO (otimização de conteúdos, palavras-chave, etc.);
  • Apoiar na criação e revisão de textos (posts, e-mails, landing pages);
  • Acompanhar métricas básicas de campanhas e gerar relatórios simples;
  • Dar suporte às demandas do time de marketing LATAM;
  • Organizar materiais, cronogramas e fluxos de comunicação com áreas internas;
  • Apoiar em ações de branding e campanhas institucionais.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Marketing, Publicidade, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Interesse em marketing digital, redes sociais e SEO;
  • Conhecimento básico em ferramentas como Google Analytics, Excel e plataformas de redes sociais;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização;


O que buscamos:

  • Perfil proativo, curioso e com vontade de aprender;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente multicultural;
  • Interesse em atuar com diferentes países da América Latina.


Informações adicionais:

  • Vaga afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD);
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: Comercial (segunda a sexta-feira).

title: Vmware Consultant
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a VMWare Cloud Engineer expert in Cloud Formation to work remotely for a client in the US.


The VCF expert will design, deploy, and support modern VMware infrastructure. This role focuses on building stable, scalable environments using vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and SRM, while enabling hybrid‑cloud capabilities.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Deploy and manage VCF, including management and workload domains.
  • Implement and optimize vSphere, vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, and SRM.
  • Troubleshoot issues across compute, storage, and network virtualization.
  • Perform capacity planning, health checks, and risk assessments.
  • Produce documentation and operational handoff materials.
  • Support DR architecture and testing.
  • Provide knowledge transfer to customers and internal teams.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • MUST BE an expert in VMWare Cloud Foundation
  • Experience with VCF or large‑scale VMware deployments.
  • Strong understanding of virtualization, networking, and storage.
  • Hands‑on with at least two: vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, SRM.
  • Familiarity with HCI platforms (e.g. Dell VxRail).
  • Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.

Preferred

  • VMware certifications (VCP/VCAP/VCIX).
  • Experience with automation (PowerCLI, Ansible, Terraform).
  • Exposure to AWS/Azure/GCP and hybrid integrations.
  • Knowledge of backup/storage platforms like PowerStore or Veeam.
  • Previous experience in Consulting and/or client facing roles

title: CargoGestor de Tráfego Pago - Marketing Jurídico
description:
Gestor de Tráfego – Especialista em Marketing Jurídico (Vaga para quem já atua no nicho)

A ADV Leads existe para ajudar advogados e escritórios a conquistarem clientes pela internet, com foco em geração de demanda + estruturação comercial para transformar lead em contrato.

Estamos contratando um Gestor de Tráfego para assumir campanhas em Google Ads e Meta Ads, com responsabilidade total por planejamento, execução e otimização.



Importante (leia antes de se candidatar)

Essa vaga é exclusiva para profissionais com experiência comprovada em marketing jurídico.

Se você nunca rodou campanhas para advogados/escritórios, ou não domina as particularidades do nicho (como OAB, prazos de maturação, qualidade do lead e jornada de contratação), essa vaga não é pra você.



O que você vai fazer aqui

  • Planejar, criar e otimizar campanhas no Google Ads e Meta Ads;
  • Construir estratégias para gerar leads qualificados para serviços jurídicos (com visão de funil e fechamento);
  • Garantir compliance com o Código de Ética da OAB (sem promessas, sem sensacionalismo, sem infração);
  • Rodar testes A/B de criativos, ofertas e páginas (em parceria com o time);
  • Analisar dados e gerar insights práticos (não só relatório) para melhorar resultado;
  • Participar de alinhamentos internos e, quando necessário, ajudar no direcionamento com cliente.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com tráfego pago no segmento jurídico
  • Domínio de Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 e Looker Studio;
  • Perfil analítico, dono do resultado, organizado e rápido na tomada de decisão;
  • Boa comunicação para alinhamentos e direcionamentos.

Diferenciais

  • Ter liderado ou apoiado time de tráfego;
  • Vivência em agência de marketing jurídico;
  • Cases em áreas competitivas (ex.: trabalhista, previdenciário, bancário, família etc.).



Como se candidatar

Envie currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail: “Gestor de Tráfego Jurídico”

title: Lead QA Engineer - AI/ML
description:
Job Title: Lead QA Engineer - AI/ML

Location: Remote (Brazil/Mexico)

Contract


About Smart IT Frame:

At Smart IT Frame, we connect top talent with leading organizations across the USA. With over a decade of staffing excellence, we specialize in IT, healthcare, and professional roles, empowering both clients and candidates to grow together.


Role Overview

  • We are seeking a highly skilled, forward-thinking Lead QA Engineer to drive our quality strategy, with a strong emphasis on test automation and AI-driven testing solutions.
  • This role combines leadership, technical expertise, and innovation to deliver high-quality software at scale.
  • You will lead QA initiatives, mentor a team of engineers, and champion modern approaches to quality engineering, including machine learning and AI-assisted testing—while maintaining deep expertise in manual and blackbox testing practices.


Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and implement the QA strategy with a focus on automation-first and AI-enhanced testing.
  • Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers across both manual and automation disciplines.
  • Establish best practices, standards, and KPIs for quality engineering.

Automation Excellence

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks.
  • Drive adoption of CI/CD-integrated testing pipelines.
  • Ensure high test coverage across:
  • UI
  • API
  • Performance
  • Security layers

AI-Driven Testing

  • Evaluate and implement AI/ML tools for:
  • Test generation
  • Maintenance
  • Defect prediction
  • Leverage AI for:
  • Intelligent test case prioritization
  • Self-healing test scripts
  • Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and integrate them into QA workflows.

Manual & Blackbox Testing Leadership

  • Define and oversee comprehensive blackbox testing strategies, including:
  • Exploratory testing
  • Usability testing
  • Regression testing
  • End-to-end testing
  • Ensure thorough validation of business requirements and user flows without reliance on internal code knowledge.
  • Lead complex manual testing efforts for new features, edge cases, and high-risk areas.
  • Establish best practices for:
  • Test case design
  • Test data management
  • Defect reporting

Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to embed quality throughout the SDLC.
  • Participate in architecture and design discussions to ensure testability and scalability.

Quality Advocacy

  • Promote a culture of quality ownership across teams.
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure timely defect resolution.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in both automated and manual (blackbox) testing methodologies.
  • Proven experience designing and executing:
  • Detailed manual test plans
  • Exploratory testing
  • End-to-end validation
  • Deep understanding of blackbox testing techniques, including:
  • Equivalence partitioning
  • Boundary value analysis
  • User-centric validation
  • Strong expertise in test automation frameworks:
  • Selenium
  • Playwright
  • Cypress
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language:
  • Python
  • Java
  • JavaScript / TypeScript (preferably)
  • Experience with CI/CD tools:
  • Jenkins
  • GitHub Actions
  • GitLab CI
  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies and SDLC.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML tools in QA (e.g., test generation, visual testing, anomaly detection).
  • Familiarity with AI-powered testing platforms or frameworks.
  • Experience balancing manual exploratory testing with automation strategies in complex systems.
  • Experience with performance testing tools:
  • JMeter
  • k6
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms:
  • AWS
  • GCP
  • Azure
  • Experience with containerization:
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes


Key Skills

  • Leadership and team development
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for AI in testing
  • Strong analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to deeply understand user behavior through manual testing approaches


Apply today or share profiles at

title: Senior/Principal .NET Developer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative engineers who are eager to build innovative products and embrace new technologies at a leading hedge fund. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists building next‑generation platforms to optimize investment decisions.


Responsibilities:

As a Frameworks Developer, you will play a key role in building and evolving the firm’s core application framework used by development teams across the organization. This is a highly collaborative, hands‑on role with broad impact.


Key responsibilities:

- Plan, develop, and support the firm’s in‑house application framework

- Define and contribute to low‑level architecture and core design decisions

- Partner with development teams to help kickstart new projects and provide technical expertise

- Collaborate with developers and business users across the organization to deliver mission‑critical platforms and services

- Support investment professionals across equities, credit, and other major asset classes

- Work closely with the broader Technology team on cross‑functional initiatives


Mandatory Skills Description:

- At least 8 years of professional software development experience

Deep expertise in

- C#,

- ASP.NET,

- SQL Server

- Good working knowledge of Angular, JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML, CSS

- Full SDLC experience: requirements, implementation, testing, release, and support

- Strong focus on clean, high‑performance code (SOLID principles)

- Experience with multi‑threaded programming

- Proven ability to build scalable, high‑availability applications and support production systems

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including technical discussions

- Strong team‑oriented, collaborative working style

- Independent, proactive mindset with a high level of ownership and collaboration


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- CI/CD systems (TeamCity, Octopus Deploy)

- Financial products (equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc. and related terminology)

- Order management systems (i.e., Charles River)

- Working with market data (i.e., Bloomberg Terminal, Bloomberg APIs)

- Workload automation and enterprise job scheduling software (i.e., ActiveBatch)

- Profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the whole stack


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Peoplesoft DBA
description:
PeopleSoft Database Administrator (DBA)

Job Summary:EY is seeking a highly skilled Senior PeopleSoft DBA with 8+ years of experience to lead the administration, maintenance, and optimization of PeopleSoft environments (HCM, FSCM, or Campus Solutions). The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Oracle/SQL Server database management, PeopleTools architecture, and proven experience managing complex 24/7 production environments.


Core Responsibilities:

Environment Management: Lead installation, configuration, and maintenance of PeopleSoft application servers, web servers (WebLogic), and process schedulers.

Upgrades & Patching: Manage full-cycle PeopleSoft Image (PUM) updates and PeopleTools upgrades; execute Oracle database patching and version upgrades.

Performance Tuning: Perform advanced performance tuning at both Oracle database level (SQL tuning, indexing) and PeopleSoft application level (App Server/Batch tuning).

Data Integrity & Security: Implement robust backup and recovery processes using Oracle RMAN; manage PeopleSoft security (roles, permission lists, SSO).

Automation: Develop automation scripts (Shell, Python, PowerShell) for environment refreshes, backups, and monitoring.

Disaster Recovery: Design and test Disaster Recovery (DR) plans using Oracle Data Guard or similar tools.

Mentorship: Provide leadership and guidance to junior DBAs; collaborate with PeopleSoft Developers and Functional Analysts.


Technical Skills Required

PeopleTools:Extensive experience with PeopleTools 8.5x – 8.6x (Application Designer, Data Mover, Change Assistant) Database:Mastery of Oracle 19c/21c, SQL, PL/SQL, RMAN.Experience with Exadata or OCI is a plus Middleware:Deep knowledge of Oracle WebLogic, Tuxedo, Integration Broker (IB) Operating Systems:Expert-level proficiency in Linux/Unix (OEL, RedHat) and shell scripting Tools:Hands-on experience with PeopleTools or Stat for version control and migrations

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados (DBA)
description:
O objetivo desta função é fornecer know-how técnico para as nossas soluções de marketing de banco de dados. A função exige profundo conhecimento de conceitos de banco de dados relacionais e proficiência em SQL. A função será responsável por criar e modificar o código de banco de dados, bem como ajudar com os aspectos operacionais do banco de dados.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Tem experiência com a aplicação prática de conceitos relacionais de banco de dados, armazenamento de dados e gerenciamento de arquivos.
  • Tem uma compreensão sólida de SQL e da linguagem de programação de base de dados.
  • Tem uma compreensão sólida das ferramentas e dos conceitos de ETL.

  • Tem conhecimento de metodologias e ferramentas de desenvolvimento.

  • Participa e contribui com revisões de projeto e código.
  • Desenvolve código para atender às especificações de projeto e realiza testes de unidade precisos no código desenvolvido.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Experiência com a aplicação prática de conceitos relacionais de banco de dados, armazenamento de dados e gerenciamento de arquivos.
  • Compreensão sólida de SQL e da linguagem de programação de base de dados.
  • Domínio das ferramentas e dos conceitos de ETL.
  • Experiência com a aplicação prática de ferramentas de programação de trabalho.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias e ferramentas de desenvolvimento.
  • Entendimento sólido de ofertas comuns de TI, como armazenamento, backups e sistemas operacionais.

title: Talent Matcher (Recruiter) - 75290
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Matcher (recruiter) to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical and technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfillment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfillment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfillment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter (good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical or technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfillment.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.


Application process

  • Work experience based questionnaire
  • Aptitude analytical assessment
  • 2 live rounds of interview discussion

  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter (good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.


Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical or technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfillment.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.


Application process

  • Work experience based questionnaire
  • Aptitude analytical assessment
  • 2 live rounds of interview discussion

title: Event Management Engineer (Spyglass)
description:
Observability & Event Management Engineer (Spyglass)

Remote

Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Spyglass Event Configuration Management Primary Focus
  • Design and implement Event Correlation Rules within Spyglass to aggregate disparate logs and metrics into meaningful business events
  • Configure Event Policies Suppression Rules and Deduplication logic to reduce alert fatigue for L1L2 support teams
  • Build and maintain Spyglass Dashboards that provide real-time visibility into the health of the FMCG application landscape Experience Engineering Mobile and Emerging Tech
  • Integrate Spyglass with diverse data sources Azure Monitor GCP Cloud Logging AWS CloudWatch and ELK Falcon Log Scale
  • Manage the lifecycle of an event from ingestion and normalization to correlation alerting and archival
  • Proactive Monitoring SRE Integration
  • Develop Threshold based and Anomaly detection alerts to identify performance degradation before it impacts the consumer experience
  • Implement Service Level Objective SLO monitoring within Spyglass to track the reliability of critical business paths eg Order-to-Cash Checkout flows
  • Automate the creation of incidents in ITSM tools eg ServiceNow based on Spyglass event triggers
  • Build Situation Rooms or high level executive views within Spyglass for major promotional events or seasonal peaks
  • Hyper scaler Platform Connectivity
  • Ensure seamless event ingestion from Hyperscaler hosted microservices AKSGKE and serverless functions
  • Support the monitoring of Integration Platforms Boomi APIM by capturing and correlating middleware execution events
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to monitor network latency and connectivity events across the global Azure GCP backbone
  • Senior Developer Specifics
  • Lead the architectural design of the Global Event Management Strategy
  • Define enterprise standards for event metadata severity levels and correlation patterns
  • Mentor junior developers in event driven observability and AIOps principles
  • Conduct Post Mortem analysis of major incidents to refine Spyglass correlation rules and prevent recurrence


Primary Skills Must-Have

  • Spyglass Event Management Expert level proficiency in Spyglass configuration rule writing and dashboarding
  • Event Correlation Deep understanding of event patterns deduplication and suppression logic
  • Observability Integration Hands-on experience connecting Spyglass to Azure Monitor GCP Stackdriver or ELK
  • ITSM Integration Proven experience integrating event platforms with ServiceNow or similar tools
  • Data Normalization Ability to parse and normalize logs events from heterogeneous sources JSON XML Syslog


Secondary Skills Good-to-Have

  • AIOps Familiarity with machine learning based noise reduction and predictive alerting
  • Scripting Proficiency in Python or JavaScript for custom event processing or API integrations
  • Cloud Native Experience monitoring Kubernetes AKSGKE environments
  • FMCG Domain Understanding of critical business hours and high traffic windows for retail sales applications.

title: Audio/Voice Trainer (Portuguese) - 74562
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We're seeking a skilled Portuguese (Brazil) Voice Actor to bring characters and stories to life across various domains, using their voice to capture the right emotion, personality, and tone.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Record voice-overs from a professional home studio or in-studio sessions
  • Perform lines with clarity, emotion, and appropriate pacing
  • Interpret scripts and take creative direction
  • Revise performances based on feedback
  • Deliver high-quality audio files on time and in the correct format


Requirements:

  • Previous voice acting experience
  • Strong vocal control and versatility
  • Clear speech and emotional range
  • Access to high-quality recording equipment (for remote roles)
  • Ability to follow direction and meet deadlines


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with dubbing, ADR, or localization
  • Demo reel showcasing a variety of voice styles
  • Background in acting or performing arts
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • This is a flexible agreement , not a full-time or part-time employment position.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisting based on qualifications and relevant professional experience.
  • Shortlisted candidates will undergo a delivery review, after which they will be ready to start!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Programador Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um Programador Pleno talentoso e motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e tem experiência em desenvolvimento de software, essa pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você!


Requisitos:

  • Estrutura de Dados: Conhecimento avançado em estruturas de dados, algoritmos e práticas de otimização de código.
  • Programação Orientada a Objetos: Experiência sólida em programação orientada a objetos e suas melhores práticas.
  • Banco de Dados Relacional: Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais, incluindo design, consultas SQL e otimização de desempenho.
  • Linguagem de Programação Java 8+: Proficiente em Java 8 ou superior, com experiência comprovada em projetos de médio a grande porte.


Conhecimento Desejável:

  • Linguagem Scala: Familiaridade ou experiência com a linguagem Scala.
  • Quarkus: Experiência com o framework Quarkus para desenvolvimento de aplicações Java.
  • Spring: Conhecimento em Spring Framework, incluindo Spring Boot.
  • Docker: Experiência em containerização de aplicações usando Docker.
  • Linux: Familiaridade com o sistema operacional Linux e suas ferramentas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações de software de alta qualidade.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e entregar novas funcionalidades.
  • Participar de revisões de código e garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Identificar e corrigir problemas de desempenho e bugs em aplicações existentes.

title: Estagiário de Marketing e Redes Sociais
description:
Sobre a vaga


Vaga: Estágio em Marketing e Redes Sociais

Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) dinâmico(a) para atuar no setor de Marketing, contribuindo ativamente para a nossa presença digital por meio do relacionamento diário com nossa comunidade nas redes sociais, auxiliando na produção de conteúdos multimídia e dando apoio operacional em nossas rotinas de publicação.


Tipo de vaga:

  • Trabalho Remoto (Home Office) | Estágio não obrigatório.


Salário:

  • R$1.067,90


Regime

  • Home office


Jornada:

  • 30h semanais


Benefícios:

  • Auxílio-alimentação de R$364,06;
  • Auxílio-saúde de R$98,65;
  • Auxílio home-office de R$123,78;
  • Vale-inglês: curso de inglês completo + exclusivo instrutor de idioma por IA, disponível para o colaborador e um dependente;
  • Vale-alemão: curso de alemão + exclusivo instrutor de idioma por IA, disponível para o colaborador e um dependente;
  • Clude Saúde: consultas médicas + nutricionista + desconto em farmácias;
  • C4Life: terapia online, diagnóstico e análise de comportamento, coaching, consultorias jurídicas, e mais;
  • Totalpass: 20 mil academias e estúdios, totalplay, totalclub, queima diária, terapia, nutrição;
  • Grupo de motivação fitness;
  • Bradesco Odonto: opção por contribuição, aberto a dependentes, com urgência, 2 limpezas por ano e exames + clube de vantagens.
  • Treinamentos em vendas, marketing e gestão;
  • Kit de boas vindas;
  • #EUVISTOACAMISA: novas camisetas da escola a cada novo ano de empresa;
  • Day-off no aniversário + presente surpresa;
  • Convênio com o SESC: clubes, hospedagem, cursos, eventos e serviços para família;
  • Bônus Indique e Ganhe.


Principais atividades:

As principais atribuições do(a) estagiário(a) se darão no auxílio às tarefas de:

  • Gestão de Comunidades: Auxiliar no monitoramento e na interação ativa com o público, respondendo a comentários, mensagens diretas (DMs) e dúvidas em todas as nossas plataformas (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube e Blog);
  • Produção de Conteúdo: Auxiliar na criação de materiais visuais atrativos para as redes sociais (carrosséis, posts estáticos e stories) e na redação de descrições (copies) engajadoras;
  • Gestão de Publicações: Dar apoio ao agendamento e à postagem de conteúdos em múltiplos canais, incluindo redes sociais, WordPress (artigos), YouTube (upload de aulas) e grupos de transmissão (WhatsApp, Telegram e Discord);
  • Suporte Estratégico e Administrativo: Participar de reuniões de alinhamento, apoiar operacionalmente a equipe e auxiliar na atualização de planilhas de controle.


Perfil:

  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Boa organização e gestão de tempo;
  • Autonomia e disciplina para atuar e render bem em um ambiente 100% remoto (Home Office);
  • Perfil proativo e curioso com vontade real de aprender, se desenvolver profissionalmente e trazer novas ideias para a equipe.


Requisitos :

  • Familiaridade como usuário e criador nas principais plataformas (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok e Telegram);
  • Dispor de um ambiente tranquilo para trabalhar, com internet estável, smartphone e um computador com bom processamento, equipado com webcam, mouse e teclado;
  • Vídeo de apresentação devidamente enviado (instruções abaixo).


Diferenciais (não obrigatório) :

  • Conhecimento prático em Canva para o auxílio na produção de peças visuais rápidas (stories, carrosséis, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com o uso de IAs generativas (ChatGPT, Gemini , etc.) para auxiliar em pesquisas, ideias e otimização de rotinas;
  • Experiência básica com Notion para acompanhamento de tarefas;
  • Conhecimento básico em WordPress (focado na postagem e formatação de artigos);
  • Domínio do idioma inglês e/ou alemão .


Preferencialmente, deve estar cursando :

  • Marketing;
  • Jornalismo;
  • Relações Internacionais;
  • Administração de Empresas;
  • Publicidade e Propaganda;
  • Relações Públicas;
  • Comunicação Social;
  • Gestão Comercial;
  • Comércio Exterior;
  • Design Gráfico.


Sobre a empresa:

  • A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma edtech brasileira, fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-inglês. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina. No inglês, destaca-se com metodologia inovadora de aprendizagem acelerada e índice de 98,9% de satisfação. A empresa irá capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês, possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e tem valor de mercado superior a 30 milhões de reais.


Etapas do processo:

  • Seleção de currículos + vídeo de até 1 minuto (instruções abaixo);
  • Entrevista 1;
  • Entrevista 2;
  • Aprovação.


Inicio: maio/2026


Instruções para o Vídeo de Apresentação e Envio

Como a comunicação é fundamental para essa vaga, queremos te conhecer além do currículo! Grave um vídeo rápido seguindo as orientações abaixo:


Duração:

No máximo 60 segundos.


Apresentação Pessoal:

Conte rapidamente quem é você (nome, idade, cidade/estado onde mora e o que estuda).


O seu match com a vaga:

Explique como as suas habilidades, experiências ou o seu perfil podem contribuir para os resultados do nosso setor de parcerias comerciais.


Expectativa de aprendizado:

Diga rapidamente o que você espera aprender e desenvolver no dia a dia desse estágio.

Dica: Não se preocupe com edições complexas ou superprodução. Seja autêntico(a), demonstre sua energia e certifique-se apenas de que o áudio esteja claro e o ambiente bem iluminado.


Prazo para envio: 05/05/2026.

Envie o seu currículo atualizado junto com o vídeo para o Whatsapp ou e-mail:

Email: Whatsapp:

Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!


#VemSerVericoder

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Especificar e executar testes funcionais em aplicações mobile (Android/iOS);
  • Criar e manter cenários de testes utilizando Gherkin ;
  • Realizar testes funcionais em APIs REST ;
  • Reportar e acompanhar bugs junto ao time de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com o time de produto para garantir que os critérios de aceitação estejam claros e testáveis;
  • Apoiar na evolução dos processos de qualidade dentro do time.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência com testes funcionais em mobile ;
  • Conhecimento em Gherkin e metodologias BDD;
  • Noções básicas dos conceitos de qualidade de software ;
  • Familiaridade com testes em APIs REST (via Postman, Insomnia ou similares);
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Conhecimento em Robot Framework ;
  • Experiência com automação de testes;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Benefícios:

  • Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.

Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Develop data integration services that accelerate customer onboarding processes.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Senior Go Developer

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead


Important Information


Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts
  • Advanced English skills.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;

title: Gerente de Projetos Sr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Gerente de Projetos Sr

contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • ntender requisitos gerais do projeto vendido (pré-vendas, consultoria e comercial);
  • Planejar o trabalho a ser realizado para atender às necessidades do projeto e da governança (PMO);
  • Atuar como ponto focal da Mercado Eletrônico no acompanhamento de projetos executados por consultorias parceiras, garantindo o alinhamento com os padrões de qualidade e governança (PMO) da companhia; atuação em dois modelos:
  • Diretiva – exercer a cogestão em projetos críticos, atuando como facilitador técnico-funcional na Plataforma ME e mediador estratégico no relacionamento com o cliente para viabilizar o cronograma;
  • Suporte – prover suporte metodológico e garantir a integridade do portfólio sob gestão da Consultoria, monitorando prazos e entregáveis.;
  • Realizar a gestão proativa de riscos e issues, antecipando desvios que possam impactar o sucesso da implantação no cliente;
  • Garantir a aderência ao escopo contratado, gerenciando as expectativas do cliente e das consultorias em relação a itens de não-escopo;
  • Formalizar a aceitação das documentações, produtos e fases do projeto;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios de status do projeto;


Será bacana se você tiver:

  • Superior completo Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida na implantação de plataformas SaaS/PaaS, com foco em integração de sistemas e substituição de sistemas legados;
  • Conhecimento no processo de Compras (Procurement) será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia com a Plataforma Mercado Eletrônico ou soluções correlatas de mercado será considerada um diferencial relevante;
  • Fluência em inglês e/ou espanhol será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento avançado de MS Project ou ferramenta similar;
  • Conhecimento avançado de algumas metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBoK /Ágil/ Outras);
  • Soft skills: comunicação, negociação e liderança;
  • Atributos de resiliência: positividade, foco, flexibilidade, organização e proatividade;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados - Tech Lead
description:
Aqui na CWI Software, estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Engenheiro(a) de Dados para atuar em contrato CLT, no modelo remoto , junto a um cliente do segmento financeiro de grande porte, referência no mercado nacional.


Você irá atuar em projetos de alta complexidade, com alto rigor técnico, segurança e escalabilidade, contribuindo diretamente para soluções críticas e estratégicas no setor financeiro.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente a construção e evolução de pipelines de dados Batch e Streaming;
  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de dados baseadas em Data Lake e Lakehouse;
  • Atuar na modelagem e engenharia de dados, garantindo escalabilidade e qualidade das soluções;
  • Implementar e supervisionar processos de ingestão, transformação e qualidade de dados (Data Ingestion, Transformation e Data Quality);
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas de negócio e times técnicos, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas;
  • Promover boas práticas de governança e controle de acesso a dados;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, incentivando colaboração, visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados Batch e Streaming;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de dados (Data Lake e Lakehouse);
  • Experiência com modelagem e engenharia de dados;
  • Conhecimento em processos de ingestão, transformação e qualidade de dados;
  • Experiência com Databricks;
  • Experiência com Azure;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Experiência com Kafka e mensageria;
  • Conhecimento em governança e controle de acesso a dados;
  • Comunicação sólida com áreas de negócio e times técnicos;
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas;
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico;
  • Capacidade de influência técnica e colaboração com o time.

Certificação Databricks.

title: Marketing Specialist - Remote, Brazil Wowoo · Full-time · 100% Remote
description:
Marketing Specialist - Remote, Brazil Wowoo · Full-time · 100% Remote

About Wowoo Wowoo is a global consumer technology company building AI-powered mobile applications used by millions of people around the world. Our portfolio includes ChatPrime, AI Baby Generator, and FaceForm. We grow through one of the most sophisticated performance marketing engines in the mobile app space, and we're expanding our marketing team in Brazil.

We pay in USD, work fully remote, and run marketing as a data-driven discipline.

The Role We're hiring a Marketing Specialist to join our global growth team. You'll work across paid social, content, creator partnerships, and lifecycle marketing for our consumer subscription apps. This role is ideal for someone with 2-4 years of marketing experience who wants to level up at an international company and work on campaigns that reach millions of users worldwide.

You'll work directly with senior marketers, designers, and founders, and your work will have measurable impact from week one.

What You'll Do

  • Plan, launch, and optimize marketing campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Google Ads
  • Brief creative concepts and collaborate with designers and video editors to produce high-performing ad creative
  • Coordinate with creators and influencers to source UGC and content for paid amplification
  • Analyze campaign performance in BigQuery, Looker, and platform dashboards; turn insights into action
  • Run A/B tests on creative, audiences, landing pages, and onboarding flows
  • Support content and lifecycle marketing initiatives across email, push, and in-app messaging
  • Stay on top of trends, formats, and platform changes in the mobile and consumer app space

What We're Looking For

  • 2-4 years of marketing experience, ideally in performance marketing, growth, or digital agency settings
  • Hands-on experience running paid campaigns on Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, or Google Ads
  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable working with metrics like CAC, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and LTV
  • Sharp eye for creative; able to brief, evaluate, and iterate on ad concepts
  • Strong written English; able to collaborate with a global team and present findings clearly
  • Native or fluent Portuguese
  • Self-directed, organized, and comfortable owning projects end-to-end in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing mobile apps, subscription products, or DTC brands
  • Familiarity with MMPs (Adjust, AppsFlyer, Branch) and mobile attribution
  • Experience working with creators or running influencer campaigns
  • Basic SQL or comfort pulling your own data
  • Background in copywriting, content marketing, or organic social
  • Portfolio of campaigns or case studies you can walk us through

What We Offer

  • Competitive USD compensation, significantly above local market
  • 100% remote, work from anywhere in Brazil
  • Meaningful ownership of campaigns reaching millions of users
  • Real budget to test, learn, and scale what works
  • Flexible hours and async-first culture
  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and tools

Who Should Apply If you've been running campaigns at an agency and want to go in-house at a product company, this is for you. If you're at a Brazilian startup and want international exposure with USD pay, this is for you. If you're a creative marketer who loves data as much as ideas, we want to hear from you.

  • Wowoo is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy solving complex data challenges, we’d love to hear from you. Send to

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js) | Integração
description:
Descrição da Empresa: A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Nosso impacto abrange mais de 8 milhões de pessoas, trabalhando com operadoras líderes como Hapvida e Porto Seguro. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde.


Descrição do Cargo: Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com forte visão arquitetural e experiência em sistemas de alta escalabilidade para atuar no time de integração da Carefy. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.

Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.


Qualificações

  • Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software
  • Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção
  • Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização
  • Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD)
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka)
  • Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados
  • Domínio de frameworks como NestJS e/ou Next.js
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração)
  • Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo
  • Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto
  • Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno
  • Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz


Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com PHP: Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


Atribuições:

  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;
  • Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;
  • Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (NestJS/Next.js);
  • Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;
  • Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;
  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.

title: Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. This individual will be a hands-on consultant responsible for developing scalable planning models, supporting integrations across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms, and partnering with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to deliver business-critical planning capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, strong financial planning knowledge, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-impact system solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning
  • Develop and optimize complex models including dimensions, sheets, versions, assumptions, and driver-based logic
  • Design, support, and improve integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms
  • Partner with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to translate planning requirements into sustainable system solutions
  • Troubleshoot model and integration issues and improve overall system performance, scalability, and usability
  • Create clear documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support long-term ownership and adoption
  • Act as a senior consultant, owning delivery quality and supporting key stakeholder relationships


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience
  • Proven experience architecting and building Adaptive Planning solutions, not just maintaining existing models
  • Deep expertise in:
  • Dimensions
  • Sheets
  • Versions
  • Assumptions
  • Driver-based planning logic
  • Complex calculations
  • Performance tuning and model optimization
  • Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP
  • Strong understanding of planning data structures, financial data flows, and integration best practices
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and FP&A processes , including budgeting and forecasting
  • Ability to connect technical configuration decisions to business and financial outcomes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or recurring revenue business models
  • Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards
  • Background in multi-entity or high-growth organizations
  • Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, hands-on consultant comfortable owning solution delivery end to end
  • Strong technical builder with business-facing communication skills
  • Able to operate independently while partnering across multiple functional teams
  • Skilled at balancing architecture, execution, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management
